releaseNotes:
• Google Play Protect Security Hardening: Signed with dedicated RSA-2048 production release key and secured internal components to eliminate harmful app warnings
• Ultra-Fast 1-Second Link Resolution: Pre-warmed background engine with Desktop User-Agent eliminating ads and mobile app popups
• Instant Media Selection & Background Saving: Media selection opens instantly with zero re-resolution delay; downloads save in background
• Rapid Parallel Thumbnails in History: Deleted posts now populate cover thumbnails simultaneously in seconds
